describe: add a servo or a motor
guide: Never choose a pin. If the message does not say which pin, ask. Pins 0 and 1 are the USB connection; never use them for a part.

A small servo uses #include <Servo.h>, a Servo object, servo.attach(PIN) in setup() and servo.write(angle) in loop(). Do not power a servo or motor from a board pin: it needs its own supply with the grounds connected. Say so before writing the code.
